name: European Invasive Alien Species Rapid-Response Fund
summary: Fast-track grants for early detection and rapid eradication of newly arriving invasive alien plants and animals in the European Union, run by IUCN Save Our Species with EU funding.

geography.label: European Union (overseas countries and territories excluded, except the Canary Islands, the Azores and Madeira)

status.quote: The call for proposals is now open.

deadline.quote: Call status: Open - application deadline: 10 February 2027, 14:00 (CEST)

administered_by.quote: IUCN Save Our Species, with funding from the European Union, is pleased to launch a call for proposals under the European Invasive Alien Species Rapid-Response Fund.

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants: Organisations operating in the European Union, including conservation organisations, research institutions and public authorities

geography.quote: Geographic scope: European Union (EU overseas countries and territories are not eligible, except the Canary Islands, the Azores and Madeira)

access.quote: Apply now via the IUCN Grants Portal

window.quote: Call status: Open - application deadline: 10 February 2027, 14:00 (CEST)

amount.quote: Grants ranging from €10,000 to €50,000 are available for projects of up to 12 months.
